originalSourceText:
Q.3   Which combination describes the sensing principle of the Intel RealSense D415?

         (A) Monocular RGB imaging only

          (B) Stereo vision with active infrared projection

          (C) LiDAR with ultrasonic ranging

         (D) Thermal imaging with passive infrared sensing

          Explanation: The D415 combines RGB imaging with stereo vision and active IR
           projection for 3D information.

          Refer slide15 of lecture 57: Demonstration on KUKA KR5 Industrial Robot
